integrity: The full finite search is replayed by two independent shortest-path calculations on each candidate power automaton, followed by exact canonicalization under all state relabelings and exchange of the two letters.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to proper binary one-cluster partial finite automata on five states. It does not cover larger state sets or larger alphabets, and earlier unpublished census data could contain the same filtered cases.
title: Five-state proper binary one-cluster PFAs have threshold \(13\) in five classes
